narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures an interview with a Taiwanese baseball player reflecting on his physical state and selection for a game against South Africa. He shares personal details about having a fever before the match to show his dedication, ultimately encouraging fans to support the team through online channels. The content aims to build a connection between the athlete and his audience.
